desc: The reusable adjudication sub-machine for judgment predicates, and its per-predicate parameterization. The model never computes a judgment; it routes and finalizes it. The judgment content arrives as an input event (like a vote); everything around it — who may declare, who may contest, timeliness, threshold, finality — is decidable structure. Conditions consult outcomes via ["adjudged", pred, subject], which returns the predicate's default until an instance finalizes otherwise (session-scoped).

transitions.by: chair sua sponte, or any member via motion/point-of-order (subject to the predicate's timeliness expression)

transitions.note: value is the judgment-content input event
chair in doubt submits to the assembly; debatability follows appeal rules

transitions.threshold: majority (the assembly decides the point directly)

transitions.guard: predicate appealable; at the time of the ruling [24:3(3)]

transitions.debatability: per appeal SDC: debatable except indecorum / priority of business / undebatable question immediately pending or involved; one speech per member, chair twice
transitions.yields: table/appeal-yield-matrix governs what may be moved while appealed

machine.finality: final is binding for the session [24:1]; the recorded ruling with reasons is persuasive precedent thereafter — weight grows with repetition and consistency; overridable by later ruling, appeal, or rule change [23:10-11]
machine.timeliness_note: the point-of-order rule: at the time of the breach [23:5], with the vote-challenge window [45:9] and continuing-breach exceptions [23:6]; predicates may override below.

predicates.desc: the amendment relates to the subject of the target
abuse of form; chair's duty-veto above all admission rules; misuse of the chair's power is remediable by point of order and appeal

predicates.subject_type: incidental motion vs business at hand
predicates.desc: the residual arises-out-of test where no structural window in precedence.json decides it
chair rules on admission as a question of privilege and on interruption urgency; the admitted question becomes an ordinary main motion
germaneness of debate, personalities, motives, naming — protocol.json decorum rules are the declared standards; enforcement escalates call-to-order -> permission-to-continue vote -> naming
predicates.appealable: except indecorum rulings are undebatable on appeal [24:3(5)]

predicates.desc: the evident object is to kill or suppress the question rather than lay it aside temporarily
the postponement would defeat the question's object (converts to postpone-indefinitely reading)
each part stands alone as a complete proposition and the parts jointly equal the whole

predicates.subject_type: new motion vs a decided/live question
predicates.desc: the same-question test for renewal bars and conflicting motions; extended for amendments by the same-content-and-effect test [12:25]
progress in business or debate has made the renewed motion a genuinely new question
the member's assertion of having voted with the prevailing side; unrecorded for voice/rising votes, so established by assertion accepted by the chair
the urgency of the purpose justifies interrupting an assigned speaker now
the motion is related to the always-allowed inquorate motions, to measures to obtain a quorum, or to the conduct of the meeting while it remains without a quorum
whether an unclear ballot's meaning can be determined; if it may affect the result, the assembly decides by vote (voting.json)
